description: 560 ohm +/-1% axial metal-film resistor, MFR-25 body, 1/4 W at 70 degC, +/-100 ppm/K (Yageo MFR)
notes: Benchmark use: blinker-555 /indicator/r_lim (RL, through parts.yaml). Series data sheet record: every rating is the MFR-25 column of the ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS table. package.name is the body type the data sheet's DIMENSIONS table names (MFR-25, L 6.3 mm, diameter 2.4 mm, axial leads); the data sheet does not use the 0207 designation, so the benchmark's package = "axial_0207" constraint is a design label this record does not echo (for L2b/L5b to reconcile). Value-specific limits the vendor defines by formula are not separate figures here. RCWV is sqrt(P x R) or the maximum working voltage, whichever is less (Note under TEST AND REQUIRMENTS, page 4); for this part that is sqrt(0.25 W x 560 ohm) = sqrt(140) V, 11.8 V to three figures. A check that holds the terminal voltage to voltage_rating and the dissipation to power_rating applies exactly that rule. The Short Time Overload test applies 2.5 x RCWV for 5 s, not more than the maximum overload voltage; for this part that is 2.5 x that, 29.6 V to three figures. Not recorded because no check reads them: the 500 V voltage proof on insulation, the insulation resistance, the pulse diagrams, the test limits, forming and packing. Lifecycle: the data sheet states none, and the vendor's product page for this MPN (yageogroup.com/products/Resistors/part/MFR-25FBF52-560R, read 2026-10-24) lists the part with stock and sample ordering but no lifecycle field, so the record says unknown rather than inferring active. Source URL: www.yageo.com answers this path with a 301 redirect to the same path on yageogroup.com, a domain Yageo also operates, which served the hashed bytes. The record cites the yageo.com URL because VENDOR_DOMAINS lists only yageo.com for this vendor; curl -L on it reproduces the hash.

pins.description: Lead 1. The part is symmetric; which terminal is 1 carries no meaning.

provenance.note: Record default; more specific entries override. Yageo MFR series data sheet, MFR-25 column.

/implements.note: An axial resistor with one lead at each end; Resistor's a and b map to leads 1 and 2, and either orientation is electrically identical.

/mpn.note: Read against the vendor's part number grammar: MFR series, power rating -25 (1/4 W), tolerance F (+/-1 %), packaging B (bulk), temperature coefficient F (+/-100 ppm/degC), forming 52- (52.4 mm), value 560R. The vendor's site lists this exact MPN (product page on yageogroup.com, 2026-10-24).

/package.locator: DIMENSIONS table, Normal MFR-25 row, page 3
/package.note: The data sheet names the body by type (MFR-25, the Normal size for the -25 power code): L 6.3 mm, diameter 2.4 mm, two axial leads.

/parameters/resistance.locator: ORDERING INFORMATION (7) RESISTANCE VALUE and (3) TOLERANCE, page 2; ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS, Resistance Range row, page 3
/parameters/resistance.note: Nominal 560 ohm from the MPN's value field 560R, inside the 1 ohm to 4.7 Mohm range for E24 and E96 values. min and max are the F tolerance (+/-1 %) evaluated at that nominal (x 0.99 and x 1.01): arithmetic on stated values, so datasheet-derived.

/parameters/temperature_coefficient.locator: ORDERING INFORMATION (5) TEMPERATURE COEFFICIENT OF RESISTANCE, F = +/-100ppm/degC, page 2; ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS, Temperature Coefficient row, page 3; TEST AND REQUIRMENTS, Temperature Coefficient (IEC 60115-1 4.8), page 4
/parameters/temperature_coefficient.note: The MPN's TCR field selects this coefficient; ppm per degree Celsius is the same coefficient per kelvin. The ta range is the test's span, -55 degC to +155 degC.

/pins.note: Two axial leads, unnamed in the data sheet; named 1 and 2, role passive.

/ratings/abs_max/overload_voltage.locator: ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS, Maximum Overload Voltage row, MFR-25 column, page 3; TEST AND REQUIRMENTS, Short Time Overload (IEC 60115-1 4.13), page 4
/ratings/abs_max/overload_voltage.note: The test applies 2.5 x RCWV for 5 seconds, not more than this maximum; the duration condition is that test's. The per-value figure is in the record notes.

/ratings/recommended/ambient_temperature.locator: ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS, Operating Temp. Range row, page 3
/ratings/recommended/ambient_temperature.note: The DERATING CURVE on the same page is plotted against ambient temperature.

/ratings/recommended/power_rating.locator: ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS, Power Rating at 70 degC row, MFR-25 column, and DERATING CURVE, page 3
/ratings/recommended/power_rating.note: 1/4 W, written exactly as 0.25 W, at 70 degC ambient. The derating curve holds 100 % to 70 degC and falls linearly to zero at 155 degC; only the 70 degC rating is recorded.

/ratings/recommended/voltage_rating.locator: ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS, Maximum Working Voltage row, MFR-25 column, page 3; Note on RCWV under TEST AND REQUIRMENTS, page 4
/ratings/recommended/voltage_rating.note: The series maximum working voltage. RCWV caps the continuous voltage at sqrt(P x R) where that is less; the per-value figure is in the record notes.
